name: Key Case
teaser: A mod that adds a recreation of the Key Case container which is available on the live server, and the barter trade to buy it from Therapist.
description_html:
A simple mod which recreates the Key Case, which is available on the live servers.

The case can hold keys, keycards, Gingy keychain, key tools and keycard holders.
It can be obtained via the same barter as on live servers from Therapist LL1 and Ref LL2.

A massive thank you to DrakiaXYZ and Jehree for allowing me to use some code from their Gilded Key Storage Mod to get this working.

Also, a thank you to Dsnyder, Groovy, and Tron from Discord for helping me maintain my sanity while attempting to make the model work.
